units.source_text: 雪云笼罩着夜空，河滩上寒风萧瑟。

en.t: Snow clouds covered the night sky, and a bleak cold wind swept over the riverbank.

units.source_text: 穿着一件毛织睡衣的阿泷刚洗完澡，赤脚都冻僵了。

en.t: A-Taki, wearing a woolen nightrobe and fresh from her bath, had even her bare feet frozen numb.

units.source_text: 她吧嗒吧嗒地走着，仿佛被岩石吸住一样。

en.t: She walked along with a pattering sound, as if she had been pulled fast to the rocks.

units.source_text: 一阵阵透骨的寒气，从脚心传了上来。

en.t: Waves of bone-piercing cold rose up from the soles of her feet.

units.source_text: 她觉得腿脚冻僵的时候，心里就难受得骂道：“畜生，畜生！”

en.t: When she felt her legs and feet going numb with cold, her heart clenched in misery and she cursed, "Damn it, damn it!"
